name: Frozen primitive domain and known-voltage-path stress
scope: Isolated Ca_HVA m+h under exogenous 1 ms varying-voltage clamp. No endogenous membrane coupling or candidate retraining.
arms: exact formula using V_t only for 1 ms
frozen physical-tau width 32 using V_t only
frozen LUT linear 513 using V_t only
frozen physical-tau width 32 updated along known V path
frozen LUT linear 513 updated along known V path

contrasts.path_information: Compare each candidate's known-path and V_t-only arms; exact-formula V_t-only quantifies irreducible information loss under held-start approximation.
contrasts.representation: Compare frozen physical-tau and LUT within the same path information regime.
contrasts.domain: Report each family separately; near-singularity and voltage-extreme failure cannot be concealed by aggregate averages.

selection_policy: No model selection or retraining. Freeze candidates and development report before generating the independent sealed schedules. Sealed outcomes are descriptive only.
interpretation_limit: The known future voltage schedule is legitimate for exogenous clamp diagnostics but is not an available input to a closed-loop membrane model. Passing does not authorize a claim of coupled-neuron validity.
